|game_text=Deploy on table. [[Slave I (V){{!}}Slave I]] is destiny +2 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. During battle: while non-[Reflections 3] [[Boba Fett (Cloud City) (V) (Virtual Block 2){{!}}Boba Fett]] with Vader, neither may be excluded or lost until the damage segment, and may place this Effect in Lost Pile to make [[Boba]] Fett's total weapon destiny +3.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Vader's Bounty (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB2-50E-Vader_s_Bounty-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-vadersbounty-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-50E-Vader_s_Bounty.png]]) show the original text (see [[Vader's Bounty (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Vader's Bounty (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 50E: “Deploy on table. During battle, while non-[Reflections 3] Boba Fett with Vader, neither may be excluded or lost until the damage segment. Slave I is destiny +2 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to make Boba Fett's total weapon destiny +3.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 4, slip 50E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) reordered the text and limited the Lost Pile option to “During battle”: “Deploy on table. Slave I is destiny +2 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. During battle: while non-[Reflections 3] Boba Fett with Vader, neither may be excluded or lost until the damage segment, and may place this Effect in Lost Pile to make Boba Fett's total weapon destiny +3.”<ref name="cl-1220_50-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, slip marked E) prints the same text.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=32, page 32. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=32 Internet Archive]</ref> The Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata) (by 27 August 2012) prints it without the comma after “Vader”<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-22; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announced earlier on the Players Committee rules forum; see the history above). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref>; whether that punctuation difference is a separate version waits for a ruling. The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 8 December 2010, effective immediately<ref name="pcforum-p590153">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 8 December 2010 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=0#p590153 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then.
